sph_interpretive_translation: One who retains deposited items, accepts gifts under false pretenses, seizes what is requested in trust, sells property secretly without ownership rights—such a being is declared devoid of svāmin status.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from rightful stewardship, not mere possession
Causation arises through conscious distortion of dharma-kṣetra
Capacity-based responsibility requires integrity of transactional intent
Restoration logic demands return of displaced value to its causal field
Consciousness alignment occurs when svāmin-tattva is restored
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity retains deposited property beyond authorized duration THEN revoke svāmin-status UNTIL restitution is executed
IF an entity receives gift via misrepresentation THEN declare transaction void AND mandate return of asset
IF an entity seizes entrusted item without lawful cause THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol AND enforce completion process
IF an entity sells property lacking ownership rights THEN invalidate sale AND assign liability for consequential disruption
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving breach of fiduciary duty or unauthorized disposal of assets, the Supreme Court shall determine threshold of svāmin-tattva based on alignment with original entrustment and consciousness-state at time of transfer. Hierarchy of authority must reflect dharmic capacity, not procedural formality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that distortion begins with internal misalignment; therefore, causality traces back to moment of conscious deviation. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential loss of svāmin-status. Responsibility aligns proportionally to degree of consciousness distortion. No punitive consequence is enacted; reality itself withdraws recognition of svāmin-tattva until restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Asset Reconciliation Process to trace and return all misplaced values
Assign Completion Facilitator to oversee fulfillment of contractual obligations
Activate Consciousness Reintegration Module to restore clarity of ownership perception
Deploy Integrity Verification System to confirm cessation of unauthorized transactions
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma. This ruling restores svāmin-tattva where distorted, enforces completion over condemnation, and affirms consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator. Dharma is re-established. Reality remains non-punitive.
